describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): ratify orthogonal identities and the exact-release law (#802)

rule: Each fixture is one mutation of the unmodified inventory. The validator accepts the unmodified inventory (positive control) and refuses every mutation with the named reason. A mutation is applied only to the row it names; every other row stays as committed. Owners, paths and acceptance IDs are checked against the controller-owned plan, never against a repository copy of it. The same checks apply to findings rows that credit a production deletion (CAT-F04, CAT-F05, CAT-F06): the owner must be a plan node whose charter authorizes a production change and covers every path on the row, the successor path must be a predecessor chain from CAT0, and the receiving acceptance must be that owner's sole-owner deletion criterion. No owner is credited a production obligation its charter does not cover. CAT0 ships the data; UAI0 ships the validator.
